conclusions.best_existing_positive_predecessor: A85 lensing-to-dynamics consistency, with A80 morphology degeneracy treated explicitly. Replication requires truly independent spectra and measured per-lens light profiles.
conclusions.strongest_explicit_sealed_euclid_falsifi: SP1 and SP2 carry hashes and owner preservation, but belong to retired routes and their frozen rejection inequalities conflict with the predicted drop. Preserve seals; report ambiguity, do not silently repair.
conclusions.cleanest_current_formula_question: One globally calibrated kappa and redshift-tracking a0^2 proportional rhoDE, with kernel/lensing metric frozen and gas/environment measured. No Foundation-only complete test established.
conclusions.no_known_prior_matches: No case-sensitive ECLIPSE token and no slitless-velocity/gradient co-occurrence found among eligible prior md/py files. This does not prove no conceptually related prediction; strong-lens tests extensively pre-exist.
conclusions.no_full_theory_pass: Selected records contain scoped mean-consistency passes, computational checks, inferred-component fits and mixed blind predictions; none demonstrates a healthy scalar-gravity completion passing all stated lensing, clusters, forest, growth and normalization gates.
